# Monitor single-fault injection (generated by scripts/monitor_fault_sim.py)

Controls: healthy monitors: good at 16.6/17.4 V span and 1.97/2.07 V neg; every H and Q excursion caught.

Masked thresholds are listed only for faults that leave 'good' high (or undetermined) at normal rails. '1' = not caught, 'k_u' = caught or not depending on an undetermined comparator.
